about: The Bluesky accounts the desk reads for injury and role news (fastnews.mjs, news-signals.mjs postSignals; DECISIONS.md D49). Each one checked on 2026-10-19 through the public AppView (app.bsky.actor.getProfile and app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed): it exists, posted in the last week, and its posts carry injury or lineup news (posts: of its last 100, the share in the last 7 days naming a status or an injury). A mirror is an account that reposts the reporter's own posts from elsewhere, marked so. Add one only after the same check.

nfl.who: NFL News Poster: the insiders' posts relayed, each tagged with its reporter
NFL News Reposter Bot: Pelissero's, Garafolo's and Russini's posts relayed
NFL Daily News: transactions and injury moves

nba.who: RotoWire NBA: player news, the statuses game by game
NBA Daily News: the insiders' news relayed

nhl.who: DailyFaceoff Toronto: the Leafs' lineup notes
